title: derris timorensis
intro: Derris timorensis, commonly known as the East Timorese derris or East Timorese roucou, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Derris timorensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include rotenoids, rotenone, and other flavonoids, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Derris timorensis on human health, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments.
